text: The hand-off said this repository has no convention for amending a delivered spec and told me to raise the question and wait. It has one: CLAUDE.md says never amend, extend by reference, and PAWL-022 is the precedent. Neither option the hand-off proposed is the house rule — editing in place is forbidden, and marking the original 'superseded by' would itself be an edit to an immutable spec. Proceeded on the existing convention rather than waiting on a question already answered
